summary: Person fell from an inflatable canoe into the Colorado River around mile marker 15 on Colorado River Road and was swept away in a fast current; found unresponsive by a party member and pulled to shore; CPR unsuccessful, pronounced dead on scene. Party of three in three separate inflatable canoes, all wearing PFDs; identity not released.
location: Colorado River around mile marker 15, Colorado River Road
notes: Agencies per ECSO release: Vail Public Safety Communications Center, Eagle County Paramedic Services, Gypsum Fire Rescue, Eagle County Sheriff's Office, Eagle County Coroner's Office.
